identity.title: Control Center Alpha Factory + Evidence / Research Lineage
identity.objective: Expose verified Alpha Factory research memory and Alpha Discovery evidence and lineage as one bounded read-only /alpha Control Center workspace: pure projections over load_and_verify_alpha_factory_registry and load_and_verify_alpha_discovery_registry inside the existing src/operator_cockpit_research.py, six GET-only FastAPI routes, typed TanStack Query consumption and Research Memory / Discovery Queue panes with Storybook/MSW states, preserving exact canonical joins and research semantics without inventing qualification, Strategy/Hermes linkage, execution authority or live state.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-CC-RESEARCH-02. The cockpit returns to its 18 GET-only routes and seven frontend views; the Alpha projections, /alpha workspace, Alpha stories and contract disappear; the research module returns to the StrategyLifecycle + Hermes projection only; the two historical test guards return to their base form. No canonical Alpha Factory, Alpha Discovery, StrategyLifecycle or Hermes store, dependency, workflow, credential, runtime store, execution, live, capital or persistent product state is changed or migrated.

items.validation_rule: A29, A30 and the extended exact route-set assertion

items.required_rule: ^alphacandidate:sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$, ^alphaepisode:sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ and ^alphatriage:sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$; malformed ids 400 INVALID_INPUT before source access; valid absent ids 404 NOT_FOUND; rejected ids never echoed

unconfigured, missing, wrong-suffix, ambiguous, tampered, invalid, wrong-schema and unexpected projection failures return only {error:{code:SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE}} with 503; no internal Alpha code, SQLite text, path, traceback or raw record

memory summary returns head_entry_hash, total_rows, total_payload_bytes, counts of research_source_references, opportunity_candidates, hypothesis_families and research_episodes, and true no-authority flags; a valid empty registry returns null head and zero counts

candidates sorted by registry sequence_number DESC then candidate_id ASC; sequence is canonical registry order, not a timestamp; limit applied after sorting; count is the returned item count; is_multi_lane = len(evidence_lanes) >= 2 and COMPOSITE is never invented

candidate detail contains only same-candidate episodes (sequence ASC) and the families they reference (sequence ASC then id ASC) plus the union of their source references and deterministic evidence refs, all from the same verified snapshot

within one exact (candidate_id, hypothesis_family_id) lineage an episode is non-leaf iff another episode names it as predecessor_episode_id or reopened_episode_id; multiple leaves are displayed truthfully; a leaf is a research leaf only, never qualified, approved or tradeable
episode detail returns the exact canonical episode fields including all evidence/uncertainty/falsification/limitation text, producer provenance and true no-authority flags

each source_reference_id resolves only from the same verified Alpha Factory snapshot to source_reference_id, source_kind, source_class, source_locator, title, observed_at, content_sha256, provenance and flags; an unresolvable reference is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; source_locator is rendered as text only and never fetched
deterministic_evidence_refs are returned verbatim as opaque canonical references; no type, URL, file, experiment, gate or route is guessed

RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE means only that further deterministic qualification may be worthwhile; it is never QUAL_PASS, qualified, predictive edge proven, OOS positive, executable edge, profitable, paper ready, live ready or Gate-C eligible; negative states are exact-scope records, never global blacklists; reopen is append-only lineage
the latest recorded queue is the AlphaResearchQueueSnapshot with the greatest Discovery registry sequence_number; no wall clock; a valid registry with no queue returns 404 NOT_FOUND

queue policy, universe and every triage id resolve from the same verified Discovery snapshot; lane groups core, exploration, audit, deferred, skipped_ineligible and skipped_capacity preserve the canonical arrays and order; audit_seed is omitted
universe coverage_scope BOUNDED_OBSERVED_UNIVERSE and external_universe_completeness UNPROVEN are always shown; the queue is the latest recorded discovery queue, never live, current or all-Polymarket

triage detail returns the triage fields, a bounded summary of the exact universe market (rule/book counts only) and the exact material change event when material_change_event_id is non-null; any unresolvable reference is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
the only Discovery to Alpha relationship is the stored matched_candidate_ids, matched_hypothesis_family_ids and matched_research_episode_ids; no textual or fuzzy join
NOT_BOUND when triage.alpha_registry_head_entry_hash is null; no Alpha record is resolved
UNAVAILABLE when the triage binds a head but the Alpha Factory store is unconfigured or cannot be verified; matched ids stay visible; the Discovery route still succeeds
HEAD_MISMATCH when both sources verify but the Alpha snapshot head differs from the bound head; no id is resolved against the wrong snapshot

RESOLVED only when the bound head is non-null and equals the verified Alpha snapshot head exactly; then only matched_* ids resolve; a matched id missing or of the wrong type under a matching head is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE

no join between Alpha candidates/families/episodes and StrategyVersion, StrategyFamily or Hermes assessments by title, label, question, thesis, subject or evidence refs, receipts, provenance or hash text
no qualification route, list, packet construction, gate evaluation or PASS inference; no qualified/approved/tradeable/profitable/execution_ready/paper_ready/live_ready/gate_c_passed field
no parsing of docs/gate_evidence/S10-GATE-AF1/af1_gate_evidence.json or any package-specific AF1 evidence and no alpha_factory_gate import

frontend adds exactly /alpha with Research Memory and Discovery Queue component-local tabs; primary navigation /overview /markets /experiments /strategies /hermes /alpha /paper /audit; required non-authority notices present
